Total Surface Area of cylinder = 2 × π × r(r + h)

\n

\n

\n

Alternate Method

\n

\n

\n

\n

Formula Used:

\n

Total Surface Area of Cylinder = 2 × π × r × (r + h)

\n\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (22/7) × 21 × (21 + 5)

\n

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × 22 × 3 × 26

\n

⇒ Total Surface Area = 44 × 78

\n

⇒ Total Surface Area = 3432 cm2

\n

∴ The correct answer is 3432 cm2.

\n

Additional Information

\n

Curved Surface Area of a Cylinder

\n

The curved surface area includes only the lateral surface: CSA = 2 × π × r × h.

\n

Volume of a Cylinder

\n

The capacity of a right circular cylinder: Volume = π × r2 × h.

\n

Total Surface Area of a Cone

\n

TSA of a right circular cone = π × r(l + r), where l is the slant height (√(r2 + h2)).

He sells his goods at 12% less than the fixed price. Find the profit percentage correct to two places of decimal.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "1.07%"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "2.08%"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "0.08%"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "3.01%"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "रमन अपने माल का विक्रय मूल्य, क्रय मूल्य से 16% अधिक पर निर्धारित करता है। वह अपने माल को निर्धारित मूल्य से 12% कम पर बेचता है। दशमलव के दो स्थानों तक सही लाभ प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "1.07%"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "2.08%"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "0.08%"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "3.01%"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Shortcut Trick\n

We can use the effective percentage change formula: Net % = x + y + (x × y)/100

\n

Here, Markup (x) = +16% and Discount (y) = −12%

\n

Net Profit % = 16 − 12 + (16 × −12) ÷ 100

\n

Net Profit % = 4 − 1.92 = 2.08%

\n

∴ The correct answer is 2.08%.

\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Markup percentage = 16%

\n

Discount percentage = 12%

\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ Let the Cost Price (CP) of the goods be 100.

\n

⇒ Marked Price (MP) = CP + 16% of CP = 100 + 16 = 116

\n

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = MP − 12% of MP

\n

⇒ SP = 116 × (100 − 12) ÷ 100

\n

⇒ SP = 116 × 0.88 = 102.08

\n

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = 102.08 − 100 = 2.08

\n

⇒ Profit Percentage = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100 = (2.08 ÷ 100) × 100 = 2.08%

\n\n

∴ The correct answer is 2.08%.

\n

Additional Information

\n

Effective Percentage Formula

\n

When a value undergoes successive percentage changes of a% and b%, the net percentage change is given by: Net % = a + b + (a × b)/100.

\n

Direct Relation between CP and MP

\n

The ratio of Marked Price to Cost Price can be calculated directly using Profit and Discount percentages: MP/CP = (100 + P%) ÷ (100 − D%).

\n

Discount Calculation

\n

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP), not the Cost Price (CP). Selling Price (SP) = MP − Discount.

दिया गया है:

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ निर्धारित विक्रय मूल्य = 116

\n\n

वास्तविक विक्रय मूल्य = निर्धारित विक्रय मूल्य - निर्धारित विक्रय मूल्य का 12%

\n\n

⇒ वास्तविक विक्रय मूल्य = 116 - (12/100) × 116

\n\n

⇒ वास्तविक विक्रय मूल्य = 116 - 13.92

\n\n

⇒ वास्तविक विक्रय मूल्य = 102.08

\n\n

लाभ प्रतिशत = (विक्रय मूल्य - क्रय मूल्य)/(क्रय मूल्य) × 100

\n\n

लाभ प्रतिशत = (102.08 - 100)/100 × 100

\n\n

लाभ प्रतिशत = 2.08/100 × 100

\n\n

लाभ प्रतिशत = 2.08%

\n\n

{"prompt": "3", "value": "\\(\\frac{4}{15}\\)"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "\\(\\frac{3}{16}\\)"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    Shortcut Trick\n

    ⇒ The given expression is: (sin2 C + cos2 C) ÷ (1 + cot2 C)

    \n

    ⇒ Using basic trigonometric identities: sin2 C + cos2 C = 1 and 1 + cot2 C = cosec2 C

    \n

    ⇒ The expression simplifies directly to: 1 ÷ cosec2 C = sin2 C

    \n

    ⇒ We are given tan C = √3, which implies angle C = 60°.

    \n

    ⇒ Therefore, sin2 60° = (√3 / 2)2 = 3/4.

    \n

    ∴ The correct answer is 3/4.

    \n

    Alternate Method

    \n\n

    Given:

    \n

    ⇒ In ΔABC, ∠B = 90° and tan C = √3

    \n

    ⇒ tan C = Perpendicular ÷ Base = AB ÷ BC = √3 ÷ 1

    \n

    ⇒ Let Perpendicular (AB) = √3 and Base (BC) = 1

    \n

    ⇒ By Pythagoras Theorem in right-angled ΔABC: AC2 = AB2 + BC2

    \n

    ⇒ AC = √((√3)2 + 12) = √(3 + 1) = √4 = 2

    \n

    Now calculate necessary trigonometric ratios:

    \n

    ⇒ sin C = AB ÷ AC = √3 / 2

    \n

    ⇒ cos C = BC ÷ AC = 1 / 2

    \n

    ⇒ cot C = BC ÷ AB = 1 / √3

    \n

    Substitute these values into the given expression:

    \n

    ⇒ Expression = (sin2 C + cos2 C) ÷ (1 + cot2 C)

    \n

    ⇒ Numerator = (√3 / 2)2 + (1 / 2)2 = 3/4 + 1/4 = 4/4 = 1

    \n

    ⇒ Denominator = 1 + (1 / √3)2 = 1 + 1/3 = 4/3

    \n

    ⇒ Final Value = Numerator ÷ Denominator = 1 ÷ (4/3) = 3/4

    \n

    ∴ The correct answer is 3/4.

    \n

    Additional Information

    \n

    Pythagorean Trigonometric Identities

    \n

    The three core identities are: sin2θ + cos2θ = 1, sec2θ − tan2θ = 1, and cosec2θ − cot2θ = 1.

    \n

    Reciprocal Functions

    \n

    The reciprocal relationships are: sin θ = 1 ÷ cosec θ, cos θ = 1 ÷ sec θ, and tan θ = 1 ÷ cot θ.

    \n

    Trigonometric Values for 60°

    \n

    For standard angle 60°: sin 60° = √3 ÷ 2, cos 60° = 1 ÷ 2, and tan 60° = √3.

    \n", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Trigonometry"], "concept": "Trigonometry", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "67160affb883ffe907ded7c2", "qs_no": 22, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "What principal would amount to ₹21,420 in 2 years at the rate of 9.5% p.a. simple interest?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "₹11,273"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "₹12,000"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "₹18,000"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "₹16,000"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "9.5% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याज की दर से 2 वर्षों में ₹21,420 की धनराशि बनने वाला मूलधन क्या होगा?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "₹11,273"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "₹12,000"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "₹18,000"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "₹16,000"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    Shortcut Trick\n

    Effective Simple Interest for 2 years = 9.5% × 2 = 19%

    \n

    Total Amount = Principal (100%) + Interest (19%) = 119% of Principal

    \n

    119% of Principal → ₹21,420

    \n

    100% of Principal → (21420 ÷ 119) × 100 = ₹18,000

    \n

    ∴ The correct answer is ₹18,000.

    \n\n

    Alternate Method

    \n

    Given:

    \n

    Amount (A) = ₹21,420

    \n

    Time (T) = 2 years

    \n

    Rate of Interest (R) = 9.5% p.a.

    \n\n

    Formula Used:

    \n

    Amount (A) = P + SI = P × (1 + (R × T) ÷ 100)

    \n\n\n\n

    Calculations:

    \n

    ⇒ Amount = P × (1 + (9.5 × 2) ÷ 100)

    \n

    ⇒ 21420 = P × (1 + 19 ÷ 100)

    \n

    ⇒ 21420 = P × (119 ÷ 100)

    \n

    ⇒ P = (21420 × 100) ÷ 119

    \n

    ⇒ P = 180 × 100

    \n

    ⇒ P = 18000

    \n

    ∴ The correct answer is ₹18,000.

    \n\n

    Additional Information

    \n

    Simple Interest (SI)

    \n

    It is the interest calculated only on the initial principal. The formula is SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

    \n\n

    Amount (A)

    \n

    The total sum at the end of the specified time period. The basic formula is A = P + SI.

    \n\n

    Effective SI Rate

    \n

    In simple interest, the overall rate percent accumulated over T years is directly obtained by R × T percent.

Find the smaller number.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "84"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "90"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "86"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "88"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "दो क्रमागत सम संख्याओं का योगफल 174 है। छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "84"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "90"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "86"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "88"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "ml": {"value": "തുടർച്ചയായ രണ്ട് ഇരട്ട സംഖ്യകളുടെ തുക 174 ആണ്. ഏറ്റവും ചെറിയ സംഖ്യ കണ്ടെത്തുക.", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "84 "}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "90 "}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "86"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "88"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    Shortcut Trick\n

    For two consecutive even numbers, their average is the exact middle odd number between them.

    \n

    Average = Sum ÷ 2

    \n

    Average = 174 ÷ 2 = 87

    \n

    Smaller even number = 87 − 1 = 86

    \n

    ∴ The correct answer is 86.

    \n\n

    Alternate Method

    \n

    Given:

    \n

    Sum of two consecutive even numbers = 174

    \n

    Formula Used:

    \n

    Let the two consecutive even numbers be x and (x + 2).

    \n\n\n\n

    Calculations:

    \n

    ⇒ x + (x + 2) = 174

    \n

    ⇒ 2x + 2 = 174

    \n

    ⇒ 2x = 174 − 2

    \n

    ⇒ 2x = 172

    \n

    ⇒ x = 172 ÷ 2

    \n

    ⇒ x = 86

    \n

    ∴ The correct answer is 86.

    \n\n

    Additional Information

    \n

    Consecutive Even/Odd Numbers

    \n

    The difference between any two consecutive even or odd numbers is always 2. If the first term is x, the series follows the pattern x, x+2, x+4, etc.

    \n

    Average of Consecutive Series

    \n

    For any arithmetic progression or consecutive sequence, the average always lies exactly in the middle of the range, which can also be calculated as (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2.

    \n

    Sum of First 'n' Even Numbers

    \n

    The sum of the first n even natural numbers starting from 2 is derived using the direct formula: Sum = n(n + 1).

    दिया गया है:

    \n\n

    दो क्रमागत सम संख्याओं का योगफल = 174

    \n\n

    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

    \n\n

    मान लीजिए छोटी संख्या x है।

    \n\n

    अगली क्रमागत सम संख्या x + 2 होगी।

    \n\n

    दो क्रमागत सम संख्याओं का योगफल = x + (x + 2)

    \n\n

    गणना:

    \n\n

    x + (x + 2) = 174

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x + 2 = 174

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x = 174 - 2

    \n\n

    ⇒ 2x = 172

    \n\n

    ⇒ x = 172 / 2

    \n\n

    ⇒ x = 86

    \n\n

    छोटी संख्या 86 है।

If the thief runs 1.5 km before being caught and the speed of the police car is 70 km/h, then what is the speed of thief's bike (in km/h)?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "65"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "60"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "55"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "50"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "hn": {"value": "एक चोर 250 मीटर की दूरी पर एक पुलिस कार को देखकर अपनी बाइक से एक निश्चित गति से भागता है। पुलिस कार चोर का पीछा करती है और उसे पकड़ लेती है। यदि चोर पकड़े जाने से पहले 1.5 किमी भागता है और पुलिस कार की गति 70 किमी/घंटा है, तो चोर की बाइक की गति (किमी/घंटा में) कितनी है?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "65"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "60"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "55"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "50"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "pa": {"value": "ਇੱਕ ਚੋਰ 250 ਮੀਟਰ ਦੀ ਦੂਰੀ 'ਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਾਰ ਦੇਖਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਆਪਣੀ ਬਾਈਕ 'ਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਨਿਸ਼ਚਿਤ ਗਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਭੱਜ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਾਰ ਚੋਰ ਦਾ ਪਿੱਛਾ ਕਰਨਾ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਉਸਨੂੰ ਫੜ ਲੈਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਜੇਕਰ ਫੜੇ ਜਾਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਚੋਰ 1.5 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ ਦੌੜਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਾਰ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ 70 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ/ਘੰਟਾ ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਚੋਰ ਦੀ ਬਾਈਕ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ (ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ/ਘੰਟਾ ਵਿੱਚ) ਕੀ ਹੈ?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "65"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "60"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "55"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "50"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    Shortcut Trick\n

    When the time of travel is constant, the ratio of speeds is directly proportional to the ratio of distances covered.

    \n

    Ratio of distances = Distance of Police : Distance of Thief = (1.5 + 0.25) : 1.5 = 1.75 : 1.50 = 7 : 6

    \n

    ⇒ Speed of Police : Speed of Thief = 7 : 6

    \n

    Given 7 units = 70 km/h ⇒ 1 unit = 10 km/h

    \n

    ⇒ Speed of Thief = 6 units = 60 km/h

    \n

    ∴ The correct answer is 60 km/h.

    \n\n

    Alternate Method

    \n

    Given:

    \n

    Initial distance between the police car and the thief = 250 m = 0.25 km

    \n

    Distance run by the thief before being caught = 1.5 km

    \n

    Speed of the police car = 70 km/h

    \n\n\n\n

    Formula Used:

    \n

    Time = Distance ÷ Speed

    \n

    Calculation:

    \n

    ⇒ Total distance covered by the police car = 1.5 km + 0.25 km = 1.75 km

    \n

    ⇒ Total distance covered by the thief = 1.5 km

    \n

    ⇒ Time taken by both the police car and the thief to reach the catch point is equal.

    \n

    ⇒ Distance of Police ÷ Speed of Police = Distance of Thief ÷ Speed of Thief

    \n

    ⇒ 1.75 ÷ 70 = 1.5 ÷ Speed of Thief

    \n

    ⇒ Speed of Thief = (1.5 × 70) ÷ 1.75

    \n

    ⇒ Speed of Thief = 105 ÷ 1.75 = 60 km/h

    \n

    ∴ The correct answer is 60 km/h.

    \n\n

    Additional Information

    \n

    Relative Speed (Same Direction)

    \n

    When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds: SR = S1 − S2.

    \n

    Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

    \n

    When two objects move in opposite directions towards each other, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: SR = S1 + S2.

    \n

    Constant Time Concept

    \n

    If two bodies travel for the exact same duration of time, the ratio of the distances they cover is directly proportional to the ratio of their speeds (D1 / D2 = S1 / S2).

    दिया गया है:

    \n\n

    चोर और पुलिस कार के बीच की दूरी = 250 मीटर

    \n\n

    पकड़े जाने से पहले चोर द्वारा चली गई दूरी = 1.5 किमी = 1500 मीटर

    \n\n

    पुलिस कार की गति = 70 किमी/घंटा = 70 x (1000/3600) मीटर/सेकंड = 70000/3600 मीटर/सेकंड = 350/18 मीटर/सेकंड

    \n\n

    प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

    \n\n

    चोर को पकड़ने में लगा समय = चोर द्वारा चली गई दूरी / चोर की गति

    \n\n

    पुलिस कार द्वारा तय की गई दूरी = चोर और पुलिस कार के बीच की दूरी + चोर द्वारा चली गई दूरी

    \n\n

    चोर की गति = चोर द्वारा चली गई दूरी / चोर को पकड़ने में लगा समय

    \n\n

    गणना:

    \n\n

    मान लीजिए चोर की गति v मीटर/सेकंड है।

    \n\n

    चोर को पकड़ने में लगा समय = 1500 / v सेकंड

    \n\n

    पुलिस कार द्वारा तय की गई दूरी = 250 + 1500 = 1750 मीटर

    \n\n

    1750 मीटर की दूरी तय करने में पुलिस कार द्वारा लगा समय = 1750 / (350/18) सेकंड

    \n\n

    1750 मीटर की दूरी तय करने में पुलिस कार द्वारा लगा समय = 1750 x 18 / 350

    \n\n

    1750 मीटर की दूरी तय करने में पुलिस कार द्वारा लगा समय = 90 सेकंड

    \n\n

    चूँकि दोनों समय समान हैं, हमारे पास है:

    \n\n

    1500 / v = 90

    \n\n

    ⇒ v = 1500 / 90

    \n\n

    ⇒ v = 16.67 मीटर/सेकंड

    \n\n

    चोर की गति को किमी/घंटा में बदलें:

    \n\n

    चोर की गति = 16.67 x (3600/1000) किमी/घंटा

    \n\n

    चोर की गति = 16.67 x 3.6 किमी/घंटा

    \n\n

    चोर की गति = 60 किमी/घंटा

    \n\n

    चोर की बाइक की गति 60 किमी/घंटा है।

    \n\n

    Shortcut Trick

    \n\nbc:Td32,\n

    ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ:

    \n\n

    ਚੋਰ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਾਰ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਦੂਰੀ = 250 ਮੀ

    \n\n

    ਫੜੇ ਜਾਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਚੋਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਤੈਅ ਕੀਤੀ ਦੂਰੀ = 1.5 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ = 1500 ਮੀ

    \n\n

    ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਾਰ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ = 70 ਕਿਲੋਮੀਟਰ/ਘੰਟਾ = 70 x (1000/3600) ਮੀ/ਸਕਿੰਟ = 70000/3600 ਮੀ/ਸਕਿੰਟ = 350/18 ਮੀ/ਸਕਿੰਟ

    \n\n

    ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸੂਤਰ :

    \n\n

    ਚੋਰ ਨੂੰ ਫੜਨ ਲਈ ਲਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸਮਾਂ = ਚੋਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਤੈਅ ਕੀਤੀ ਦੂਰੀ / ਚੋਰ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ

    \n\n

    ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਾਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਤੈਅ ਕੀਤੀ ਦੂਰੀ = ਚੋਰ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਾਰ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਦੂਰੀ + ਚੋਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਤੈਅ ਕੀਤੀ ਦੂਰੀ

    \n\n

    ਚੋਰ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ = ਚੋਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਤੈਅ ਕੀਤੀ ਦੂਰੀ / ਚੋਰ ਨੂੰ ਫੜਨ ਲਈ ਲਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸਮਾਂ

    \n\n

    ਗਣਨਾ:

    \n\n

    ਮੰਨ ਲਓ ਚੋਰ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ v ਮੀ/ਸਕਿੰਟ ਹੈ।

    \n\n

    ਚੋਰ ਨੂੰ ਫੜਨ ਲਈ ਲਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸਮਾਂ = 1500 / v ਸਕਿੰਟ

    \n\n

    ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਾਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਤੈਅ ਕੀਤੀ ਦੂਰੀ = 250 + 1500 = 1750 ਮੀ

    \n\n

    ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਾਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ 1750 ਮੀਟਰ ਦੀ ਦੂਰੀ ਤੈਅ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਲਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸਮਾਂ = 1750 / (350/18) ਸਕਿੰਟ

    \n\n

    ਪੁਲਿਸ ਕਾਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ 1750 ਮੀਟਰ ਦੀ ਦੂਰੀ ਤੈਅ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਲਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸਮਾਂ = 1750 x 18 / 350

    \n\n

    Shortcut Trick\n

    Income = Expenditure + Savings

    \n

    Given E : S = 3 : 1 ⇒ Income (I) = 3 + 1 = 4 parts

    \n

    Using the weighted average equation: E × Einc + S × Sinc = I × Iinc

    \n

    ⇒ 3 × Einc + 1 × 20% = 4 × 25%

    \n

    ⇒ 3 × Einc + 20 = 100 ⇒ 3 × Einc = 80 ⇒ Einc = 80/3% = 26 (2/3)%

    \n

    ∴ The correct answer is 26 (2/3)%.

    \n\n

    Alternate Method

    \n

    Given:

    \n

    Ratio of expenditure to savings = 3 : 1

    \n

    Increase in income = 25%

    \n

    Increase in savings = 20%

    \n

    Formula Used:

    \n

    Income = Expenditure + Savings

    \n

    Percentage Increase = (Increase ÷ Original Value) × 100

    \n\n\n\n

    Calculations:

    \n

    ⇒ Let original expenditure be 300 and original savings be 100.

    \n

    ⇒ Original Income = 300 + 100 = 400

    \n

    ⇒ New Income = 400 + (25% of 400) = 400 + 100 = 500

    \n

    ⇒ New Savings = 100 + (20% of 100) = 100 + 20 = 120

    \n

    ⇒ New Expenditure = New Income − New Savings

    \n

    ⇒ New Expenditure = 500 − 120 = 380

    \n

    ⇒ Increase in Expenditure = 380 − 300 = 80

    \n

    ⇒ Percentage increase in Expenditure = (80 ÷ 300) × 100

    \n

    ⇒ Percentage increase = 80/3 = 26 (2/3)%

    \n

    ∴ The correct answer is 26 (2/3)%.

    \n\n

    Additional Information

    \n

    Income, Expenditure & Savings Rule

    \n

    Income is the sum of expenditure and savings (I = E + S). Any percentage change in income is distributed between expenditure and savings based on their respective proportional weights.

    \n

    Weighted Average Method

    \n

    When a value is split into two parts, the net percentage change can be determined using: Total % Change = (Part1 × %Change1 + Part2 × %Change2) ÷ (Part1 + Part2). This method offers the fastest way to solve mixture and distribution type percentage problems.

    \n

    Percentage Change Formula

    \n

    Percentage Change = [(Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value] × 100. Always make sure to use the original or old value as the base denominator.

      • Ensure the sentence structure is correct and clear.
